AI Services · Kleza

Intelligence refined on your data. Deployed on your terms.

Kleza builds and deploys custom AI systems — trained on your operational reality, validated against your standards, and monitored for accuracy over time. Not off-the-shelf AI. Yours.

Talk to Our AI Team
Our Position

AI that knows your industry, speaks your language, and gets more accurate the longer it works with you.

Generic AI gives generic answers. Kleza’s AI services start with your data — your clinical notes, your operational SOPs, your caregiver workflows — and build models that understand the specific context your team operates in. The result is AI that earns trust rather than demanding it.

Operating Model

How Kleza deploys AI — responsibly and precisely.

01

Data Integrity

Every model we build starts with a thorough data audit. We identify gaps, inconsistencies, and compliance risks before a single training run begins. Your model is only as good as the data behind it — we make sure both are excellent.

02

Human Oversight

No Kleza AI system operates without a human review layer. Model outputs are evaluated by domain experts before deployment, and escalation paths to human agents are built into every assistant we deploy.

03

Continuous Evaluation

Post-deployment, Kleza monitors model performance against accuracy and relevance benchmarks. Models are updated as your data evolves. AI that doesn’t improve over time is a liability — ours improves by design.

Healthcare Focus

AI built for the complexity of healthcare — not retrofitted to it.

FAQ

Questions, answered.

Kleza offers two core AI services: Business-Specific AI Training — where we fine-tune large language models on your operational data — and AI Support Assistants, which are 24/7 conversational AI systems trained on your knowledge base. Both are available for healthcare and enterprise organisations.

Generic LLMs are trained on public data and produce generic outputs. Kleza fine-tunes models specifically on your organisation’s data — clinical notes, SOPs, communications — producing a model that understands your specific operational context and terminology.

Yes. All AI systems Kleza builds for healthcare clients use HIPAA-compliant architecture — covering data ingestion, storage, model access, and output handling. We conduct a compliance review before any healthcare AI deployment.

Timelines depend on data availability and use case complexity. A focused AI assistant typically deploys in 6-10 weeks from data discovery to go-live. Custom LLM training projects range from 8-16 weeks including evaluation cycles.

Absolutely — and the combination is significantly more powerful. A support assistant built on a model trained with your own data produces far more accurate, context-aware responses. Ask about our combined AI service packages.
